name: MiniMax H3 ControlNet (canny) — restyle a video from its outlines + audio
title: Redraw a video over its outlines
summary: Upload a clip and describe a new look; every outline of the original — clothing patterns, buildings, edges — is followed exactly, while colours, materials and sound are all new.
description:
Upload a video and describe a new look. The clip is turned into an edge map (Canny) and MiniMax H3 generates a brand-new video that follows those outlines — new characters, materials, setting and lighting — with a matching audio track made from your prompt. The original colours and sound are not kept.

Describe the scene, what happens over time, the camera and the sounds (the default prompt shows a good structure with time ranges). "Control strength" sets how tightly the result sticks to the edges. The two edge thresholds decide how much detail is traced: lower keeps faint edges (more detail, but grainy footage gets noisy and flickers), higher keeps only strong contours.

Only the first seconds of your clip are used ("Duration", default 5 s), and the video is centre-cropped to the aspect ratio you pick, so choose the one closest to your clip. Time grows with duration and size; the default 20-step render takes a few minutes, "Fast mode" (4-step turbo LoRA) is several times faster at some cost in quality.

promptGuides.label: MiniMax H3 prompt guide (ComfyUI) — what works and what does not
promptGuides.tip: Describe the new look in prose, then the sound under overall_soundscape: and the music under non_diegetic_music:. No time ranges and no negative list — this model has no negative prompt.

promptGuides.label: MiniMax H3 reference-mode prompt guide — MiniMax
promptGuides.tip: Describe the new look — characters, materials, setting, lighting — and the soundscape; the movement comes from your video. Every detail should be something you can see or hear.

Prompt (new scene / action / camera / sound)
exposedParameters.default:
Hyperreal desert-storm look. A humanoid figure made of packed sand dances alone in a barren wasteland under a searing white sky: every spin and arm swing sheds dust that trails behind it like mist in the wind, its edges crumble away and rebuild, and raised columns of sand glow gold in the hard light. By the final pose half of its body has blown away into a long hanging line of sand that has not yet fallen. Medium fixed shot, real-time speed.

overall_soundscape: A fine, continuous scrape of moving sand, the dry hiss of wind, and one distant desert wind call about two seconds in.

non_diegetic_music: none.
